other: When his passive is active, he unstaggers Le Rouge allies once per turn. In his regular form, he can unstagger a non-Le Rouge ally once per encounter. In his {st:TransformSinclair} form, he gives Le Rouge allies a single death prevention and heals them by 50% of their HP.
He gains a free {st:ChargeRougeAlly} Count whenever {st:Laceration} is activated by anyone up to 10 per turn.
In his {st:TransformSinclair} form, using his defense will consume HP to bring him to 15 {st:ChargeRougeAlly}, instantly triggering {st:BuffetSinclair} next turn.

{st:RougeFamilySinclair} effects:
- {id:10816}: With {st:RougeIshmaelEclose}, gives Sinclair max HP and HP healing on hit.
- {id:10717}: +1 {st:ChargeRougeAlly} count and heal 5% HP on hit when using {skill:11016|08}.
usage: Starts out in his regular form, then at 100+ {st:HungrySinclair} he gets a copy of his {skill:11016|10}. When he first uses this skill (including the ascended version {skill:11016|11} if used at 150 stacks), he gains {st:TransformSinclair} and transforms to his Crimson God form, replacing all his skills with his {st:TransformSinclair} skills. Subsequent uses of the skill are given whenever he has 150 stacks of {st:HungrySinclair}. The status is gained whenever he consumes {st:ChargeRougeAlly} count, he heals allies, allies take damage, or passively with Le Rouge allies.

Regular form:
- S1 and S2 targets allies and gains atk weight based on {st:ChargeRougeAlly} Potency. S1 heals HP and SP. For Le Rouge identities, it consumes HP to apply {st:ResultEnhancement} instead. At max SP, it gives {st:Charge} Count instead. S2 gives {st:ParryingResultUp} and {st:BuffetThirst}, gives {st:PersonalityCharge} {st:Charge} Count, and consumes HP for Le Rouge identities to give them {st:AttackUp}.
- Using either S1 or S2 gives a Le Rouge ally {st:BuffetFriendShield} which is an {st:SupportProtect} that uses {skill:11016|12} and only defends Sinclair.
- Will use {skill:11016|05} as a follow up to a {st:PersonalityCharge} ally's skill.
- S3 consumes HP of allies to give them {st:AttackUp} and {st:Enhancement} for Le Rouge allies.

{st:TransformSinclair} form:
- Gains buffs based on {st:ChargeRougeAlly} Potency.
- Gains a single death protection.
- Gains {st:RougeFamilySinclair} which gives him buffs based on other Le Rouge identities on the field.
- Activates {st:DinnerField} which builds up stacks when units heal HP and can be consumed by Le Rouge allies or allies with {st:BuffetThirst}.
- Gains {st:BuffetThirst} every turn.
- Gives a Le Rouge ally {st:BuffetFriendShield} which is an {st:SupportProtect} that uses {skill:11016|12} and only defends Sinclair.
- Will use {skill:11016|08} as a follow up when his target has 5 {st:BoneNailSinclair}, consuming all {st:BoneNailSinclair} to inflict {st:ScarletTakeDamageUp} next turn.
- His S2 and S3 consume HP of allies to deal more damage.

Applies {st:BuffetThirst} to allies at 3+ {kw:Lust} Reson. He also gains it every turn and applies it to more allies in {st:TransformSinclair} form. The buff allows allies to consume {st:Charge} Count to increase their damage. If they don't have {st:Charge}, it lets them consume {st:DinnerField} in place of it. If neither are available, it lets them consume 1% HP instead.

At 15+ {st:ChargeRougeAlly} Count, he consumes all stacks to gain {st:BuffetSinclair} for 3 turns, giving him {st:AttackUp}, speed, and damage buffs, while also giving him {st:Laceration}. Having the buff makes his S3s gain {st:SuperCoin} and the ability to consume {st:ChargeRougeAlly} to gain Atk Weight and Coin Power. His {st:TransformSinclair} form S1 gains more damage and S2 gains more {st:BoneNailSinclair} infliction. When it expires, it consumes all of his {st:ChargeRougeAlly} Count to heal HP.

1101602.desc:
Gain 1 [ChargeRougeAlly] Count every time [Laceration] is activated in this Encounter (10 times per turn)

Combat End: At 15+ [ChargeRougeAlly] Count, if this unit is not in [BuffetSinclair] state, consume all [ChargeRougeAlly] Count to gain 3 [BuffetSinclair] next turn
- Heal SP equal to (3 x [ChargeRougeAlly] Count consumed beyond 15) (max 15)

When [BuffetSinclair] expires, consume all [ChargeRougeAlly] Count on self to heal HP equal to ([ChargeRougeAlly] Count consumed x 2)

Gain 1 [ChargeRougeAlly] Potency for every 10 cumulative [ChargeRougeAlly] Count this unit consumes in this Encounter

This unit's Base Attack Skills and Clashable Counter Skills are considered as Skills that gain [Charge] Count
1101602.name: La Jouissance phallique

1101603.desc:
Gain [HungrySinclair] based on the following conditions (50 per turn):
- When this unit consumes [ChargeRougeAlly] Count, gain Stack equal to [ChargeRougeAlly] Count consumed
- When this unit's Base Skills heal other allies' HP, gain Stack equal to actual amount healed
- Gain 1 Stack for every 10 cumulative HP allies lost
- On Base Attack Hit by another "Le Rouge" allied Identity, gain 2 Stacks
- Turn End: Gain 5 Stacks for every other "Le Rouge" allied Identity on the field

Turn End: At 100+ [HungrySinclair], and if this unit does not have [TransformSinclair], replace the Skill on the leftmost Skill Slot's bottom row with "La Voracité" at the next Turn Start

Combat Start: If this unit equipped "La Voracité" or "La Castration" for the first time in this Encounter, gain [BuffetThirst] and [TransformSinclair]; then, remove this unit's Stagger Threshold
- Replace equipped Base Skills with [TransformSinclair] exclusive Skills
- Base Skills that targeted allies activate Unopposed Attack against random enemies
- At Attack End of the Skill activated by the said effect, consume all [HungrySinclair]

Turn End: At 150 [HungrySinclair], if this unit has [TransformSinclair], and if this unit does not have "La Voracité" on its Dashboard at the next Turn Start, replace a Base Skill with "La Voracité" (prioritizes the Skill on the leftmost Slot's bottom row)
1101603.flavor:
Who decides where childhood ends?

The crimson child set out on an adventure all on his lonesome.
Tracing memories, longing for what was lost, the child walked on with friendless steps... and in loneliness, bade farewell to childhood.
1101603.name: La Fin de l'Enfance

1101604.desc:
When this unit's Base Skill effects consume an ally's HP, the ally cannot become Staggered by the said effects, and its HP does not drop below 1.

Combat End: At 3+ Lust Reson., apply [BuffetThirst] next turn on (Lust Reson. / 3) other allies (rounded up)
- Prioritizes "Le Rouge" allies, in Deployment order

When using a [SupportAlly] Skill on an ally, apply 1 [BuffetFriendShield] to the non-immobilized "Le Rouge" ally with the highest current HP (once per turn)
At Base Attack End by another allied [PersonalityCharge], if the said Skill did not defeat its main target, use "Je vous aide" against that enemy (once per turn)

1101611.desc:
